spots.name: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda
spots.summary: The Giant Wild Goose Pagoda or Big Wild Goose Pagoda is a seven-storey Buddhist pagoda in the Daci'en Temple complex in southern Xi'an, Shaanxi, China. It was first built in 652, when Xi'an was the Tang capital Chang'an, under the direction of the monk and translator Xuanzang.

spots.name: Great Mosque of Xi'an
spots.summary: The Great Mosque of Xi'an, also known as the Huajue Xiang Mosque due to its location on 30 Huajue Lane, and is sometimes called the Great Eastern Mosque, is a mosque located in the eastern segments of the Xi'an Muslim Quarter (回民街), Xi'an, in the Shaanxi province of China.

spots.name: Shaanxi History Museum
spots.summary: Shaanxi History Museum, which is located to the northwest of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda in the ancient city Xi'an, in the Shaanxi province of China, is one of the first huge state museums with modern facilities in China and one of the largest.

spots.name: Fortifications of Xi'an
spots.summary: The fortifications of Xi'an in Shaanxi, also known as the Xi'an City Wall, represent one of the oldest, largest, and best preserved Chinese city walls. It was built under the rule of the Hongwu Emperor of the Ming dynasty to protect the city from the Northern Yuan and potential unrest.

spots.name: Stele Forest
spots.summary: The Xi'an Beilin Museum, commonly known as the Stele Forest, is a museum of inscribed stone monuments and stone sculpture in Beilin District, Xi'an. Its historical collection was established at the local Confucian temple and prefectural school in 1087.

spots.name: Bell Tower of Xi'an
spots.summary: The Bell Tower of Xi'an, built in 1384 during the early Ming dynasty, is a symbol of the city of Xi'an and one of the grandest of its kind in China and lays on the axis of the Imperial Way.

spots.name: Daci'en Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Daci'en Temple is a Buddhist temple located in Yanta District, Xi'an, Shaanxi. The temple is the cradle of East Asian Yogācāra in China. It is notable for the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda.

spots.name: Small Wild Goose Pagoda
spots.summary: The Small Wild Goose Pagoda or Little Wild Goose Pagoda is a Tang-dynasty brick pagoda in the former Jianfu Temple precinct in Xi'an, Shaanxi, China. It was built between 707 and 709, when the city was the imperial capital Chang'an, and was associated with the temple's translation of Buddhist texts brought from India.

spots.name: Xi'an Museum
spots.summary: Xi'an Museum is a museum on Youyi West Road, Beilin District, Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China. Xi'an Museum had its official opening on 18 May 2007, "National Museum Day", with a total investment of 220 million RMB and a total area of 160,000 square meters.

spots.name: Drum Tower of Xi'an
spots.summary: The Drum Tower of Xi'an, located in the heart of Xi'an, the capital of Shaanxi province, Northwestern China, along with the Bell Tower is a symbol of the city. Erected in 1380 during the early Ming Dynasty, it stands towering above the city center and offers an incredible view of Xi'an.

spots.name: Daming Palace
spots.summary: The Daming Palace was the imperial palace complex of the Tang dynasty, located in its capital Chang'an. It served as the imperial residence of the Tang emperors for more than 220 years.

spots.name: Guangren Temple
spots.summary: Guangren Temple, also called Guangren Lama Temple, is a Buddhist temple located in Lianhu District of Xi'an, Shaanxi, China. It is the only Tibetan Buddhist temple in Shaanxi.

spots.name: Jianfu Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Jianfu Temple is a Chinese Buddhist temple located at West Youyi Rd. outside the south gate of Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China. It hosts the famous Small Wild Goose Pagoda.

spots.name: Qinglong Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Qinglong Temple, also known as Shifo Temple, is a Buddhist temple located in Xi'an, Shaanxi, China.

spots.name: Temple of the Eight Immortals (Ba Xian An)
spots.summary: 是西安最大、最著名的道教观院，慈禧太后曾赐名“敕建万寿八仙宫”。这里每逢农历四月十四、十五、十六日，都要举行一年一度的庙会，很是热闹。

spots.name: Sites of the Xi'an Incident
spots.summary: The Xi'an Incident Museum's main exhibition halls are at this site.

spots.name: Wolong Temple
spots.summary: Wolong Temple is located on Baishulin St., Beilin District, Xi'an, Shaanxi Province of China. It is the earliest Buddhist temple in Shaanxi. And one of the national key monasteries of Buddhism in the Han region.

spots.name: Shaanxi Provincial TV Tower
spots.summary: Shaanxi Radio & TV Tower (陕西广播电视塔) or Shaanxi TV Tower is a free standing concrete telecommunications tower built in 1987 in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China. It is 245 metres (804 ft) tall.

spots.name: Beiyuanmen
spots.summary: “回民街”是回民西安市内多条回族聚居街道的总称，主要由由北院门、北广济街、西羊市、大皮院等数条街道组成。本地人也称那里为“回坊”。它以浓郁的穆斯林文化和氛围，构成了古城一道特异的风景线。回民街的主要街道以青石铺路，绿树成荫，路两旁一色仿明清建筑，餐饮器物均由回民经营，具有浓郁清真特色。回民街一年四季人来人往，街边各类老字号餐馆鳞次栉比，游客络绎不绝，小小的巷道内时常弥漫着美食的香气。同时，这里亦有唐代含光门、明代西城门楼群、众多保存完好的清真寺和道教城隍庙、佛教西五台等众多文化遗迹，背街小巷内的楼房也较为古老。

spots.name: Former office of Eighth Route Army in Xi'an
Xi'an Art Museum
spots.summary: Displays a wide range of artworks from both Chinese and foreign artists.

spots.name: 碑林博物馆
spots.summary: 西安碑林始建于北宋哲宗元祐二年（1087年），最初是漕运使吕大忠等人为保藏因唐末五代战乱而委弃市井的唐《石台孝经》、《开成石经》及颜真卿、柳公权等所书的著名石碑而兴建的，经金、元、明、清、民国历代的维修及增建，规模不断扩大，藏石日益增多，1961年被国务院列为全国第一批重点文物保护单位。 博物院紧邻书院门古文化一条街，大门松柏掩映，肃穆端庄。博物馆内藏有自汉代至今的碑石、墓志近3000件，展出1089件，碑石、墓志的数量为全国之最，且藏品时代系列完整，时间跨度达2000多年，篆、隶、楷、行、草各体皆有，名家荟萃，精品繁多。

spots.name: 环城公园
spots.summary: 游人常去的地段有新近整修过的永宁西苑和永宁东苑，临近南门广场，夜景漂亮。坐标为南门部分。

spots.name: Yongxingfang

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Set in a historical building complex, and translating to "the food museum" the restaurant serves traditional food from the Shaanxi province. There are also different folk cultural performances. This place is the home of the local "smashing wine bowl" tradition where you drink rice wine from a small cup, then smash it into pieces, which is supposed to bring luck.

spots.name: Small World Cafe
spots.summary: Run by a Dutch woman and her Chinese husband. Known by the older generations as "the oldest western restaurant in Xi'an", which opened in the early 70s. Great European cafe feel. Good food. Pizza, salad, fried chicken and real cake. From the windows, one could see busy Huancheng Nanlu (环城南路), while it is really quiet inside.

spots.name: Green Molly Restaurant & Pub
spots.summary: A restaurant where you can indulge in the tastes of home, whether that be in the U.S., Europe or even Mexico. The restaurant owns only the second authentic pizza oven in Xi'an. Downstairs, the first and only real pub in Xi'an has a wide selection of beverages ranging from imported beers to wine and delicious cocktails.

spots.name: Havana Bar

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Has a Colombian band and makes good cocktails. It's not your average Buena Vista Social Club, though: they play loud music in between band performances and the band plays a wide array of pop and salsa. This location is more of a club than an actual Latin bar.

spots.name: Tang Paradise Hotel

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Dinner show in a 165-acre theme park. The charm lies in that all the buildings in the park are built in the luxurious style of the Tang Dynasty. The best time to visit is at night when most of the shows, including fireworks and dances, are performed.

spots.name: Delhi Darbar

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Authentic North Indian food run by a wonderful Indian manager. Service is good, food is divinely delicious, and prices are very affordable. Mango Lassi for only ¥10 is a must-have. Average meal price is about ¥40 per person.

spots.name: Li Ming's Dumpling House
spots.summary: A tiny, family-run spot known only to locals, serving exceptional guotie (potstickers) and baozi (steamed buns) with secret-recipe fillings. No frills, just authentic flavor.

spots.name: De Fu Lou Cafe & Bar

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: In Bar Street (De Fu Xiang), one of the first bars ever to open in Xi'an and a favorite hangout for locals. Live football on the big screen and live music every night.

spots.name: Lao Sun Jia

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Has fantastic yangrou paomo which is very cheap but flavorful. No English spoken but easy to communicate with sign language! Franchises all across town.

spots.name: 北院门回民街

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: 北院门回坊文化风情街由北院门、西羊市、化觉巷组成的环形旅游散步道，全长一千一百米。街区内为仿古代明清建筑风格，南是鼓楼，北是牌坊，清真大寺、古宅大院散落于错落有致的店铺食肆之间。这里美味飘香，因饮食集中而出名，是小吃、逛街休闲的主要场所，夜间的气氛更为厚重。

spots.name: Wen Xin Jiaozi Guan

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A good cheap place for jiaozi (Chinese dumplings). There is no menu, but endless supplies of fresh jiaozi of many flavors.

spots.name: 永兴坊

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: 永兴坊占地15亩，一千四百多年前，中国史上盛名的谏臣魏征就住在这里。永兴坊汇集了陕西各地特色美食，有省级、市级非物质文化遗产美食，还有各种手工民俗技艺表演及各地名小吃，待游客来品尝。流行的摔碗酒，就是在这里。

spots.name: Tongshengxiang

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Upscale restaurant serving traditional dishes of the Hui community. Three other locations in the city.

spots.name: Zhen Er Lao Tan Suan Cai Yu
spots.summary: Traditional Sichuan restaurant, whose name translates to Sijiong Old Jar Fish With Chinese Sauerkraut.

spots.name: 德福巷

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: 德福巷如同北京的三里屯、上海的新天地一样，以自己特有的魅力潜移默化地影响着西安的夜生活，去德福巷成为追求时尚品位的西安年轻人休闲、会友的现代生活方式。

spots.name: Night Cat

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Dance floor, some foreigners and OK DJs.

spots.name: Rhythm Bar
spots.summary: Jazz bar with live music, a bit pricey.

spots.name: MIX

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Rather nice places to sit and drink.
